name: analyze-performance
description: Weekly performance read across every channel we run: what worked, why, and what to make next, judged on the business's real number (store revenue, qualified pipeline, retained users), not platform claims. Use when: write my Monday report; how are my ads doing — which ad won?; are my ads actually making money (Meta says 4x ROAS but revenue is flat); why did sales drop this week; did the test win; is my tracking working; monthly numbers for the replan; anything on fire today. Not for acting on the recommendations (pausing, scaling, launching) — use run-paid-campaigns; not for replanning the budget — use plan-campaign.
